event: Friday of week three: test day; you wake at five with your heart going, and go down to the water.

pictured.coverAfter: You can't lie there. You get up and pull on your swimsuit and your robe
pictured.outfit: cream fisherman's jumper over a dark blue towelling robe over a navy swimsuit, trainers

event: The swimmers are out in a thin rain; Shiv takes one look at your face and says, "Buoy. Now."
At the buoy she makes you breathe with her, out and out, until your hands stop shaking.

memory.fact: On test day Shiv breathed with Nala at the buoy, out and out, until her hands stopped shaking.

event: "It's a glim and a warm stone," Shiv says. "You've done both a hundred times. Stop being a gom."

memory.fact: Shiv told Nala the test is a glim and a warm stone, done a hundred times: stop being a gom.

event: At breakfast Bea eats nothing and drinks three cups of tea; Kit sits with you, white and silent.
Under the table you take Kit's hand; she grips it hard, lets go, and eats one dry triangle of toast.

memory.fact: At test-day breakfast Kit gripped Nala's hand hard under the table, then ate one dry toast triangle.

event: Nine: Penhallow's study. "Ashby," she says at once. "Whose wanting? I said Friday. It's Friday."
The room goes quiet; you think of Shiv at the buoy, the long pose, the wall by the lodge.
"Mine," you say. "Whoever I was before. It's mine now. I'm the one who wants."

She pushes the shortbread tin across the desk, all the way to you; Shiv grins at you sideways.

event: The rest of the hour Penhallow keeps it light: tea, and stories of her own first test.
"I set my eyebrows on fire," she says. "Second attempt. I passed. They grew back." Priya shrieks.

memory.fact: At her own first test, nearly forty years ago, Penhallow set her eyebrows on fire; she passed.

event: Eleven: Sigils; every line wobbles; the tutor sighs and lets you all copy glims, for calm.
Lunch: you, Bea, Kit, Lin, Shiv and Priya at one end of a table, pushing food about; Amara apart.
Two: the Practice Hall; the benches pushed back, a table at the front, the demonstrator behind it.
Forty first-years along the walls; the demonstrator reads names in order. "Ashby, N."
First, again. You walk out into the middle of the scorched floor, and every eye turns to you.
You breathe out. The sigil, the word: your glim comes, steady and pale, and holds a long count.
The demonstrator hands you a cold stone; you breathe out and it warms, steadily, bathwater-warm.
She touches it with two fingers and writes. "Pass." You walk back to the wall with your knees gone.

memory.fact: Nala passed the Friday test first: a steady glim held a long count, a stone bathwater-warm.

event: "Ashworth, K." Kit walks out into the middle of the floor; forty girls watching; she stops.
Her hand rises; the stroke, the loop; at the hook it freezes in the air. The hall goes very still.
She looks for you along the wall. You're there; Bea beside you; Lin; Shiv, arms folded, nodding.
You breathe out, slowly, visibly, for her. Bea does it too. Then Lin. Then, rolling her eyes, Shiv.
Kit breathes out. The hook turns in. The glim comes: small, then steady, clear. It holds.
The demonstrator counts it and nods; the stone in Kit's palm goes warm on her first breath.
"Pass," says the demonstrator. Kit walks back to the wall very straight, and her hand finds yours.

event: After, Amara slips out of a side door; you follow, and find her on the steps outside, dry-eyed.
"I was going to," she says. "I came out to. I can't be bothered, Freckles. Is that progress?"
You sit beside her in the drizzle, and she leans on your shoulder for a minute, and laughs.

memory.fact: After the test Amara sat outside to cry and couldn't be bothered; she leaned on Nala, and laughed.

event: Evening: the Drowned Bell's folk session; half of Hollowmere crammed in, fiddles by the fire.
As your crowd comes through the door, the landlady rings the ship's bell over the bar.
"First-years!" she shouts. "Test Friday!" The whole pub cheers, and someone thrusts cider at you.

memory.fact: On test Fridays the Drowned Bell's landlady rings the ship's bell over the bar for the first-years.

event: Half a cider, you remind yourself; it goes to your head anyway, warm and fizzing.
Shiv drags you into a reel by the fire; you have no idea of the steps; you laugh until you ache.

memory.fact: Nala never danced a reel in either life; Shiv dragged her into one, and she laughed till she ached.

event: Kit sits in the corner with lemonade, watching; when you come off the floor, she makes room.
"I passed," she says, low, as if she's still checking. "In front of all of them. I passed."
She kisses you, there, in the corner, in front of the whole pub; then goes scarlet, and stays.

memory.fact: At the Drowned Bell Kit told Nala I passed, and kissed her in front of the whole pub, scarlet.

event: Bea comes back from the bar with crisps and squeezes onto your other side, and grins at Kit.
Lin sits on the floor at your feet with her sketchbook, drawing the fiddlers, leaning on your knee.

memory.fact: At the Bell Lin sat at Nala's feet drawing the fiddlers, her head leaning on Nala's knee.

event: Across the room, Yusra is off duty in a dark jumper, a pint in her bandaged hand, by the fire.
She catches your eye, and lifts her pint to you, the way she did your first Friday here.
On your way to the loo you pass her; "Passed?" she says. "Passed," you say. "Told you," says Yusra.

memory.fact: At the Bell Yusra asked Nala Passed?; Nala said Passed; Yusra said Told you, and held her eyes.

event: She holds your eyes a moment longer than she needs to; then turns back to her friends.
At eleven you all walk the black shore path home together, arm in arm, singing badly.
Kit peels off at the gates toward Ashcombe, and kisses you, and kisses Bea's cheek, astonishingly.

memory.fact: At the gates Kit kissed Nala on the mouth, then kissed Bea's cheek, and Bea stood astonished.

event: At your door Bea stops. "Can I stay?" she says. "Just sleep. I want to be close."
In the narrow bed in 14 she curls against your back, her arm over you, her breath in your hair.
She kisses the back of your neck once, softly; "I'm proud of you," she whispers. You sleep.

memory.fact: Bea slept in Nala's bed in 14, curled at her back, kissed her neck, and whispered I'm proud of you.
